calls.title: Soham Patel and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: Philo has been utilizing Growth Book’s enterprise features for over five months without a formal contract, primarily driven by a lack of awareness. The company is seeking clarity on costs and value before commitment. Key desired features include access control and governance capabilities due to compliance needs. The transition from self-hosted to SaaS enterprise is seen as beneficial, offering maintenance relief. Philo's pricing discussion indicates a rough estimate for 50 seats on SaaS enterprise at $100,000 per year, with flexibility in initial pricing. Philo emphasizes successful experimentation by empowering PMs with tools while minimizing data scientist involvement. The potential use of AI in their operations is also being explored, alongside a smooth migration path to SaaS.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Enterprise features, Experimentation platform, Feature flags, Data science, AI integration
calls.action_items:

Compile a detailed report on GrowthBook enterprise features, cost structure, and limitations to present to Philo’s executive team for decision-making (14:07)
Meet with manager to refine plan for executive conversations and gather feedback on continuing GrowthBook enterprise usage (28:45)
Coordinate with C-suite to discuss GrowthBook enterprise continuation and cost justification based on compiled report (28:45)
Inform Cary about executives interested in attending the San Francisco AI and product dinner event and manage attendee logistics (29:20)
Schedule follow-up discussions with Cary to deepen technical or contractual conversations after initial executive reporting (30:53)

**Cary Rakin**
Provide Soham with documentation and reports summarizing GrowthBook enterprise features, costs, and limitations for executive review (14:07)
Investigate GrowthBook’s capability to scale experiment impact metrics to full traffic and arrange a technical session if needed (20:16)
Share GitHub repository of pre-built AI skills and tools with Soham to support experimentation and PM autonomy (21:51)
Facilitate technical discussions between Philo’s operations/infrastructure teams and GrowthBook for seamless migration from self-hosted to SaaS enterprise (26:45)
Offer executive alignment opportunities including CEO and CTO conversations and provide information about the San Francisco AI and product dinner event (29:03)
Follow up with Soham after initial executive discussions to progress contract negotiations and deployment planning (30:53)
